sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 features the following enhancement: Unified Vision-Language Foundation: Early fusion training on trillions of multimodal tokens achieves cross-generational parity with Qwen3 and outperforms Qwen3-VL models across reasoning, coding, agents, and visual understanding benchmarks.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B Ultra‑compact 0.8B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for edge deployment. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.
